title: A timeline row for each speaker's voice-over
summary: Translate Video splits voice-overs into one timeline row per speaker, shows trims live on audio tracks, and audio-only exports download as audio files.

sections.title: Translate Video
sections.note: Voice-overs get one timeline row per speaker.

items.body: Mute one speaker's row to drop only their dubs
**Row per speaker** merges them back into one Target row
See the whole waveform while you trim an audio track
Audio-only exports download with the right file extension
Speaker rows follow a muted Target row
Audio clips no longer jump when you start dragging them
